cereal_box.name: Vans_Cereal_Honey_Nut_Crunch_11_oz_box
cereal_box.intended_use: Closed-cuboid envelope fit. Cardboard, folded edges, and bowing are outside the ideal block grammar.
cereal_box.processing: Area-weighted surface sampling of published processed OBJ scan mesh; 12000 samples; NumPy default_rng seed 20261025; coordinates multiplied by 1000 from SDF SI metres to mm. No denoising, alignment, or fitting applied.
cereal_box.limits: Published mesh is a simplified processed physical scan, not raw sensor input. Reconstructed distances are scan-relative; manufacturing accuracy and hidden structure are unverified. Packaging shell thickness and material are unknown.
